During the [[Third Galactic War|renewed conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a mission was '''taken''' to the [[Jedi Enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] to investigate activity related to the rogue [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]].<ref name="Secrets" />

{{Mission-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
'''Mission to the Jedi Enclave''' is depicted in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'', in a flashpoint mission "Secrets of the Enclave", added in update 6.3 "Dark Descent".
===Imperial story===
For players supporting the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the events go as follows:
[[File:JediEnclaveRep-SWTOR.png|thumb|Republic forces deployed around the Enclave ruins|left|293x293px]]
After helping defeat the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] at the [[Meridian Complex]], [[Darth Malgus]] went missing. With news about his last siting, [[Darth Rivix|Lord Rivix]] came to [[Odessen]], wishing to tell the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] urgent developments. [[Hylo Visz]] informed the Commander of Rivix's arrival and the two had a meeting, in which Rivix revealed acquired by the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] recording of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] meeting, in which [[Aryn Leneer]] claimed to have seen Darth Malgus on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. To avoid spreading the knowledge of Malgus's uncontrolled actions outside of [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]'s orders, Rivix proposed a covert operation instead of a full scale assault. For the strike team which would be lead by Commander, he suggested [[Darth Krovos]], as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] with formidable fighting skills.<ref name="Secrets" />

Upon arrival to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], the team discovered that the Republic have already deployed their forces around the [[Jedi Enclave|Enclave]]. However, [[Darth Rivix|Lord Rivix]] informed the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of old tunnels which could lead to the Enclave from outside, avoiding most of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] opposition. The team moved out, dispatching several Republic patrols on the way. Upon defeating [[Graul/Legends|Graul]] in the passages underneath the Enclave, they encountered [[TL-30]], a medical droid that treated [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]] after the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]]. With some new information about rogue Sith lord, the team proceeded through the ruined libraries into the inner courtyard of the ruins, dismantling ancient guardian droids an the way. In the courtyard they were met by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Meinar]] and his team, who attempted to stop the Imperials but were defeated and Lord Rivix killed Meinar.<ref name="Secrets" />

Continuing on with the search, the team reached [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Leeha Narezz]], who came looking for [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]] as well. Both parties appeared to have missed him, and Leeha Narezz claimed that Malgus took a relic from the Enclave. In the confrontation that followed, Leeha Narezz was defeated, but suddenly [[Darth Krovos]] experienced a vision, an [[Psychometry/Legends|echo]] in the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] left by Malgus's presence in the [[Jedi Enclave|Enclave]], which she was able to feel due to a [[Force-bond/Legends|bond]] they shared through battles of the [[Third Galactic War]]. The vision revealed that Malgus removed the cybernetic devices that restricted his freedom in the past, and that the heroes walked into a trap. Indeed, the roof above them crumbled crushing on them. The team managed to barely escape the Enclave ruins, killing Leeha Narezz in the process, when she attempted to get away. Upon returning to [[Odessen]], [[Darth Rivix|Rivix]] updated the [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina|Acina]] of the new developments, and [[Eternal Alliance]] started preparing for the Malgus's next move.<ref name="Secrets" />

=== Saboteur ===
[[Saboteur/Legends|Saboteur]] players have an option of warning their secret allies about the incoming mission to the Enclave.<ref name="Secrets" />
